description: The plot illustrates validation-set perplexity (PPL) on PG-19 as a function of evaluation context length for three retaining ratios labeled by γ. The x-axis is labeled “Evaluation Context Length” and uses discrete, evenly spaced tick labels at 2K, 4K, 8K, 16K, 32K, and 64K (no units shown; values are in thousands as indicated by “K”). The y-axis is labeled “PPL,” appears linear, and spans roughly from 7.7 to 8.2 with regularly spaced tick marks at 0.1 intervals. Three solid lines with circular markers are shown: the blue line (γ=0.25) starts near 8.19 at 2K, drops to about 7.83 at 4K, is around 7.84 at 8K, decreases to about 7.78 at 16K, is near 7.79 at 32K, and ends around 7.78 at 64K; the orange line (γ=0.5) starts near 8.20 at 2K, drops to about 7.84 at 4K, decreases to around 7.74 at 8K, stays near 7.74 at 16K, is about 7.73 at 32K, and remains around 7.73 at 64K; the green line (γ=0.75) starts near 8.20 at 2K, drops to about 7.84 at 4K, decreases to around 7.75 at 8K, goes to about 7.73 at 16K, reaches about 7.72 at 32K, and stays around 7.72 at 64K.
